story.title: 'Ramayana' hits Rs 1,500 crore globally in record time
story.summary: Namit Malhotra's 'Ramayana', directed by Nitesh Tiwari, has crossed the Rs 1,000 crore mark domestically. The film achieved this milestone within just two weeks of its theatrical release. Starring Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, and Sai Pallavi, it is now the sixth Indian film to reach this figure. story.title: Larry Poindexter dies at 66, after being hit by car
story.summary: Larry Poindexter passed away at the age of 66 following an accident where he was hit by a car. He suffered significant injuries and was set to undergo surgery but died unexpectedly. Poindexter had a distinguished career spanning over four decades in television and film. He recently worked on an independent series titled 'Residual,' which remains his last project.
